note: Run these in a local Claude Code session on the Blender PC. Expected flow: job script in Blender Scripts\<Course>, background test run with renders, final run to a new .blend. The geometry itself is covered headless by scripts/selftest.py.

evals.prompt: I've put the cursor on the cart path on hole 4 where the ditch runs under it. Add a 600mm concrete pipe culvert and blend it into the meshes.
evals.expected_output: Checks/installs the kit in Blender Scripts\opcd_feature_kit; asks in one question for the course .blend and what the cursor marks; writes a job entry (kind='pipe', span=0.6, cursor_is='crossing'); runs the background test job with Blender 4.5; reads the report and renders, confirms the AUTO axis with the user; final run to a new .blend only after approval.

evals.prompt: stick a 4ft stone arch under the bank at the cursor, the burn runs roughly north east to south west. headwalls need to sit flush with the bank
evals.expected_output: Uses kind='arch', span=T.ft(4), bearing about 225 (flow NE to SW) or asks which way the water flows; mentions the arch will read as concrete once joined; checks flush_max_error in verify.

evals.prompt: Add a 24 inch corrugated steel pipe at the cursor. I've dropped CULVERT_IN and CULVERT_OUT empties at each end of the run-off so use those.
evals.expected_output: Job entry with kind='corrugated', span=0.6096, inlet/outlet set to the CULVERT_IN/CULVERT_OUT empty positions (read via MCP read-only or from the saved file); reports the fall between them and warns if it is under 1 in 100.

evals.prompt: the outlet headwall on the H4 culvert looks too tall, knock a foot off it and redo it
evals.expected_output: Edits the H4 entry in Blender Scripts\<Course>\<course>_culverts.py (edits.out_top_rel reduced by 0.3048 from the value in the last report), re-runs the background test job, shows the new renders; does not touch the open Blender or hand-patch meshes.
